name: Casino Hungarian
description: Hungarian Casino is a Royal Casino variant played in Hungary. Features numerical values for picture cards (J=11, Q=12, K=13, A=1/14) with unique building and capturing rules. Differs from Anglo-American Casino in several key ways.

history.origins: Hungarian Casino is a variant of Royal Casino played in Hungary. It represents the Central European tradition of Casino games where picture cards have numerical values, differing from the Anglo-American version where picture cards can only capture matching pictures.
timeline: Traditional: Played for generations in Hungary
history.cultural: Popular in Hungary and potentially neighboring regions. The game is part of Hungary's card game heritage, alongside games like Ulti and Preferansz.
history.evolution: Hungarian Casino evolved from the broader European Royal Casino tradition. The key development was assigning numerical values to all cards, enabling more complex building and capturing combinations.

setup.deck: Standard 52-card pack. Card values: 2-10=face value, J=11, Q=12, K=13, A=1 or 14.
setup.dealing: Standard Casino dealing: cards to players and to table layout.

rules.objective: Capture cards from the layout. Score points by capturing specific cards and achieving majority of cards/spades.
rules.gameplay: Hungarian Casino follows Royal Casino rules: All cards have numerical values. Players capture by matching card values or sums. Building allowed: single builds (sum=value) and potentially multiple builds. Picture cards participate in numerical captures and builds. Ace flexible at 1 or 14.
keyRules: Capture by matching or summing to played card value
